name: dynamodb-bulk-executor
description: Run bulk operations against large Amazon DynamoDB tables — count, find, scan, SQL, update, delete, fill, copy, diff, load, and export replay — using an AWS Glue Spark job for massive parallelism.

interface.shortDescription: Count, query, backfill, copy and diff huge DynamoDB tables via AWS Glue.
interface.longDescription: Drive Bulk Executor for Amazon DynamoDB: run bulk operations across tables far too large for a scripted loop, using an AWS Glue Spark job for parallelism. Covers counting and finding with Spark SQL predicates, sorting on any attribute without a GSI, parallel-scan counts with skew reporting, arbitrary Spark SQL, generator-driven updates and backfills, deletes, synthetic data fills, cross-region and cross-account copies and diffs, S3 loads, and replaying or reverting DynamoDB exports — with the cost, capacity and point-in-time-recovery guardrails each one requires.
defaultPrompt: How many items in my DynamoDB table match this condition?
Backfill a new attribute across every item in this table.
Compare these two DynamoDB tables and tell me what differs.
